messages:
Elena (People Ops): Quick announce  two small but important updates effective 2027-01-01: (1) Paid Volunteer Leave (PVL) pilot: 16 hours/year to volunteer with eligible charities, and (2) mental-health day clarification: up to 3 consecutive days can be taken without medical documentation. Full policy links below.

Tara (Benefits): PVL is separate from PTO and does not roll over. It's intended to support local volunteering during work hours and is available after 90 days of employment.

Ibrahim (Recruiting): Nice! Can we advertise PVL to candidates? That's a strong differentiator.

Elena (People Ops): Yes  we'll add a short blurb to the careers page and recruiter one-pager. PVL is voluntary; teams are encouraged to coordinate so business needs are covered.

Marcus (Legal): Eligibility: volunteers must work with registered nonprofit or community organizations; political campaign activity is excluded. We'll publish an approved org list and a simple self-attestation form.

Tara (Benefits): Managers approve PVL in the normal time-off flow. If multiple folks request overlapping PVL for the same day, managers should prioritize business-critical coverage or suggest alternate days.

Ibrahim (Recruiting): Does PVL count as time worked for benefits accrual?

Tara (Benefits): PVL counts as paid time for service and benefits eligibility (e.g., tenure-based benefits) but not for overtime calculation. Payroll will mark PVL with code "PVL" for reporting.

Elena (People Ops): Mental-health day clarification: we heard feedback that people were unsure about needing a doctor's note. For up to 3 days, no documentation required; managers should treat requests the same way they would for short-term sick leave and respect privacy.

Marcus (Legal): Important: if an employee requests accommodation or extended leave for a mental-health condition, that triggers the usual ADA/STD review and documentation may be required. This clarification is only for short, single-episode days.

Tara (Benefits): If employees take more than 3 consecutive sick days we'll advise them of options (STD, EAP, FMLA where applicable) and the manager will loop People Ops.

Wellness-bot: Policy & request forms: https://intranet.redwood/workplace/policies/pvl-mental-health-2027. EAP resources: https://wellness.redwood/eap.

Ibrahim (Recruiting): Any guidance on team culture messaging? Some managers worry people will use PVL as extra PTO.

Elena (People Ops): Suggest framing PVL as an encouraged benefit; sample messaging will emphasize coordination and that it's for organized volunteer activities. We'll provide a 1-slide manager kit and suggested Slack lines.

Tara (Benefits): Payroll note: PVL code available from first payroll in Jan 2027; sample CSV export will include pvl_hours.

Marcus (Legal): We'll also add a short compliance checklist for cross-border deployments  some countries have different rules about charitable leave. For now pilot covers US, CA, UK, and DE.

Elena (People Ops): Timeline: manager preview 2026-12-01, employee announcement 2026-12-08, pilot starts 2027-01-01, pilot review after Q1 2027. Please add comments to the doc if you see issues.

Ibrahim (Recruiting): :clap: Excited to share this with candidates.

Elena (People Ops): Action items: publish manager kit by 2026-12-05, add PVL blurb to careers page, and schedule a short AMA for 2026-12-10. DM me for edge cases.
